content: Bonchcho Toofiloosa, nu gancce polintteez baza gaamitay, paasi danda7intteezay garkk xaafeeza.
Ye taarika u xaafeezay tiinapp aykkii aafe markkitayinnee qaala odii maaddizitay nuus odeeza.
Taakka ta baggar tiinapp akaakii be7eezaypp guye ye taarikay hana lo7ithii nees Toofiloosas xaafay taas lo77o maaqqii bentteeza.
Yeykka, ne tamaareez bazay tuma maaqqeeza erisodayissii. Xammaqiza Waannisa yelintto
Yihuda kaat Herodoosa wode Abiya baggapp maaqqeez Zakkireesa giz Ayihude qeesay yeza. E machchatakka Aaroona sheeshippe. I sunthaykka Elssabeexo.
Nam7aykka Goday wogannee azaza ubba naagii borso bayith Xooss tiina xillotithar yeziza.
Elssabeexa dhoonth maaqqeez gisho unttis na7a baaya. Nam7aykka cimeeza.
Pettii gallas Zakkireesa fa tarar Xooss tiina qeesetitha oothiza.
Qeesetith wogar Xooss kara gelii ixaannee cuyishshodayis eza ixa helleeza.
E Ixaannee cuyshshodar asay bale eqqii woossiza.
Goday kiitanchchay yarshsho yarshshiza aqaypp ushachch baggar eqqii bentteeza.
Zakkireesa kiitanchchana bi7ii dagammii iita yashittii pokkeeza.
Zin kiitanchchay eziko, «Zakkireesa yashitippe; ne woosay sintteeza. Ne machchat Elssabeexa dhiirathi na7a yeloda, e sunthakka ne Waannisa goda.
E nees ufayssi maaqqoda; gaamitay e yelinttayid ufayttoda.
Goday tiina E ubbaypp bayira maaqqoda; woyne ushshii maaqqin hara mathisiz ushshii uzhaamii. Fa indat ulo yezar Geeshsha Ayyanar kumoda.
Isreele asitayipp gaamita u Goda Xoossayiko mahoda.
Aditay wozina na7itayiko mahoda, kiitinttoozita xillitay ecetithayiko mahodaygarkk, Godayis beeziza asa giigisodayis Eelaasa ayyarannee wolqqar Goday tiinar yhammada» yeegeeza.
Zakkireesa kiitanchchayiko, «Ta yeya abar erodee? Taarannee ta machchatir cimeeza» yeegeeza.
Kiitanchchay mahii, «Ta Xooss tiina eqqiza Gabreele. Yha mishiraachcha nees ododayis Xoossapp kiitintteeza.
Yikkee, woday helin polinttiza ta qaala ne ammanaam ixxeez gisho yhayi polinttod hellodayis ne muume maaqqoda, odinttodayiskka danda7aamii» yeegeeza.
Ye wode Zakkireesa Xooss kara gelii gam7eez gisho abi haneezako gi asay bale naagttar gam7eeza.
E bale kezii unttar nashshodayis danda7ekkaya. Kusher mallii beezoppe attin odinttodayis danda7oozana bi7ii abukka be7eezaygarkk qoppeeza.
Zakkireesa yarshsho woda wurssii fa kara maaqqeeza.
Yeyppe guye, e machchat Elssabeexa wodexxeeza. Ichchin agina muume keethapp kezekkazar gam7eeza.
Iza, «Goday fa maarotithayir ta borintta asay ganccepp qaarodayis koyii yhaya ootheeza» yeegeeza.
Yesuusa yelinttay tiinatii odintteeza
Elssabeexa wodexin usuppuntho aginar, Xoossii kiitanichcha Gabreelena Galila biitta yez Naazirete katama kiiteeza.
Ezii wuddiritiko Dawute sheeshapp maaqqeez Yooseefa giz athayis ushintteez Mayiramiko kiittintteeza.
Kiitanchchay iziko yhanigii, «Aadho keehatithar kumeezannee, saro nees maaqqo, Xooss neer yeza» yeeggeeza.
Mayrama e odayid iita dagammii, «Yhayi waafa sarotho» gi qoppeeza.
Kiitanchchay mahii, «Mayirame, yashittippe; ne Xooss tiina Saaba dengeeza.
Yikkee ne woddexxoda dhiirath na7a yeloda, e sunthakka Yesuusa gi sunthoda.
E gita maaqqoda, Ubbaypp Aadho Xooss na7a ginttinttii xeeginttoda. Xoossay E aday Dawute zufaana ees inggoda.
E Yayqqooba sheeshal afa medhinas kawutoda; e kaatetithayis zawa baaya» yeegeeza.
Mayirama kiitanchchayiko, «Ta dhiirath erooya Yeyi wayizii hanodayis danda7ee?» yeegeeza.
Kiitanchchay mahii, «Geeshsha Ayyana neell afa wodhdhoda, Ubbap Aadho Xooss wolqqay neell afa kuyatoda. Yey gisho, yelinttiza na7ay geeshsh, Xooss Na7akka ginttinttoda.
Yikkee, ne dabbat Elssabeexa fa cimatith laythar dhiirathi na7a woddexxeeza. Iza dhoonth ginttintteezano, zin yhatte usuppuntha agina aykkeeza.
Xoossa gamizbaz baaya» yeegeeza.
Mayirama, «Yeezako, taas Goday ayllatis, ne qaalay garkk hano» yeegeeza. Yeyppe guye, kiitanchchay iippe shaakintteeza.
Mayirama ye saaminttate dendii Yihuda biitta yez pettii gezze katama yhanigeeza.
Zakkireesa kara gelii Elssabeexo sarotheeza.
Elssabeexa Mayiramii sarotha si7eezannii garkk I ulo yez na7ay ufayisar doonggeeza. Elssabeexa Geeshsha Ayyanar kumii,
fa qaala dhoqqi udii, «Neenii maachchitay gancceppe anjjintteezano, ne wodexeez na7aykka anjjintteezaya.
Hano zin, ta Goday indatee, ne taako ye7odayis ta oonoo?
Yeezako ne sarotha ta si7in ta ulo yez na7ay ufayisar doonggeeza.
Goday polod gi inggeez qaala ammaneezana, iza anjjitteezano» yeegeeza.
Mayramii Galata mazmuure
Mayirama yhayigarkk yeegeeza:

content.text: ta Ayyanay ta dhale Xoossal ufayttiza.
Yhayinope aykkii yeletithi ubbay tana anjjitteezano goda.
Wolqqama maaqqeez E, taas dammabaz ootheeza.
e maarotithay medhinapp medhina hellodayis yeziza.
Fa miinth qesayir fa wolqqa beezeeza,
Afraamesinnee e sheeshayis geezana medhinas polodayisii»

content: yeegeeza.
Mayirama Elssabeexi lanqqe hayidzii agina gam7ii fa kara maaqqeeza.
Xammaqiza Waannisa yelintto
Elssabeexis yelo qammay hellin dhiirath na7a yeleeza.
I shooritaynnee I dabbitay Goday gaame maarotith ootheezana si7ii, izir wolla ufaytteeza.
Hosppuntha gallas duude na7ana dookalodayis ye7eeza. Na7ana aday sunthayir Zakkireesa gi xeegodayi koyeeza.
Zin indat, «yey hannena Waannisa giinttinttodayis beeziza» yeegeeza.
Unttikka, «Ne dabbitaypp yha sunthayir xeegintteezay oonkka baaya» yeegeeza.
E aday oona gi sunth gaddodazako erodayis kozhii eza mallar oycceeza.
E xaafiza baz oyccii ekkii, «E sunthay Waannisa» gi xaafeeza. Ubbay E xaafezana bi7ii malabaz geeza.
Izir Zakkireesa iranthay bilintteeza, Xooss galatittar odintto aykkeeza.
Shooritay ubbitay yashshar kumeeza. Yha haneezibazay Dhoqqi geez Yihuda gade ubbayid odintteeza.
Yeya si7eez ubbay, «Yha na7ay ab hanodeshsha» gi woli gancce odintteeza. Goday kushay ezar yeza.
Zakkireesa tinbbite
Waannisa aday Zakkireesa Geeshsha Ayyanar kumii yhay garkk yeegii tinbbite odeeza.

content.text: Yeykka binii wode geeshsh nabitay doonayid odintteezay garkk,
Yeya E ootheezay nu aditayis fa maarotithi beezodaysinnee,
Ma ta na7ayyo, ne Ubbapp Aadho Xooss nabe ginttinttoda.
Godayis oge loythodayis ne e tiina yhammada.
Unttii atotith eretith demmadana, u nagaray atto ginttinttin,

content: yeegeeza.
Na7ayikka dicceeza, Ayyanarakka miinggeeza, Isreele asayis benttod gatho liizho demba yezeeza.
